objective: Outperform matched-schedule SPY in compounded net price return while respecting the provisional 20% portfolio drawdown research target; scenario evidence is not certification
stock_benchmark: Equal initial weights in every saved feature-ready member of the same historical sample and decision, without conditioning on forward availability
market_benchmark: SPY price return at the same scheduled next-open entries and 21st-session close exits; this is not continuous buy-and-hold SPY or total return
portfolio: 75% equity and 25% zero-return cash at each scheduled entry; fixed shares during the holding window, no leverage, no daily rebalancing
cost_convention: Same round-trip fee on initial invested notional for all portfolios, half at entry and half at exit; no netting, including scheduled SPY liquidation/re-entry
unresolved_path: Keep all originally unresolved positions at relative value 1 until the final mark, then apply the declared terminal scenario; never drop or renormalize missing weights
metrics: Remove each pair's best excess-return period from both portfolios; return sensitivity only, not a stitched drawdown
assessment: Report development, later and full-history views for each disjoint sample and all saved scenarios; strictly positive compounded excess versus SPY plus drawdown no worse than -20%; no annual return hurdle invented
limitations: Objective chosen after prior results; previously examined dates are not a fresh holdout
Equal exposure is not equal risk; no claim of risk-matched alpha
Price return excludes dividends, cash interest and taxes for every portfolio
Daily closes omit intraday extremes; missing-path stresses are assumptions, not bounds
Matching turnover costs and overnight cash gaps makes a controlled scheduled comparison, not a real passive-investment comparison
No tuning, model fitting, new ticker sample, database writes or live promotion
